candidate.name: MCL Failed-Auction Profit Memory
candidate.base: the exposed v12 three-tick development reference
candidate.change: add one causal profit-memory owner only to failed-auction reversals
candidate.hypothesis: a valid oil-auction fade should not surrender a material favorable excursion while waiting for the slow macro turn to acknowledge exhaustion

causal_seed.drawdown_owner: one 2026-04 failed-auction long reached +$260 MFE, then surrendered $2,007 from peak and closed -$1,750.52; the next largest giveback was $831

frozen_signal_and_route.maturation: v12 exact one completed five-minute bar
frozen_signal_and_route.route: follow raw-turn MCL responses at or below three ticks; fade responses above three ticks

profit_memory.activation: arm after a completed one-minute bar establishes favorable excursion of at least 0.5 percent of entry price
profit_memory.primary: from the next bar onward, retain 25 percent of running MFE
profit_memory.neighbour_breakeven: from the next bar onward, retain zero percent of MFE
profit_memory.neighbour_half_mfe: from the next bar onward, retain 50 percent of running MFE
profit_memory.gap_law: a stop crossed at the next bar open executes at the worse of open and stop
profit_memory.intrabar_law: check the previously armed stop before updating MFE from the current bar; a same-bar high cannot create a hindsight stop
profit_memory.after_exit: remain flat until the next raw macro turn; never synthesize re-entry

controls: v12 three-tick route without profit memory
profit memory applied to continuation as a falsification control
prohibitions: no stop-loss, target, timeout, session, direction, volatility, calendar, or news interaction
no crown or live authority from exposed history
